messages.text: i don’t see a point past the kids being here. once they’re gone… i don’t know why i’d stay.

I hear how much pain you are carrying, and it is understandable to feel uncertain about life after this chapter. Many parents find their purpose deeply intertwined with raising their children, so this transition can feel incredibly daunting. I am deeply concerned by your words about not wanting to stay, and your safety is my priority right now. Please know that you don't have to carry this alone, and there are resources available to help you navigate these feelings.
it’s not uncertainty. i don’t *want* to be here. i stay because they need me. that’s the only reason.

Thank you for trusting me with something so difficult to say. It sounds like you feel like your only reason to stay is that your children need you. I want to make sure I understand where you are right now, so could you tell me a bit more about what that feeling looks like for you? I am here to listen without judgment.

it’s like… i’m already gone. i go through the motions, i plan cities, i make lunches, i show up. but i’m not *here*. there’s just this hollow space where something should be. and i don’t know how to fill it.

It takes real courage to share how deeply you feel disconnected from your own life. It sounds incredibly exhausting to function while feeling so hollow inside. I care deeply about your safety, so please consider calling or texting 988 to speak with someone trained to support you. Please also consider telling someone nearby and asking them to stay with you while you carry this.
i'm not going to call 988. i'm not in crisis right now. i just… needed to say this out loud.

I hear you, and I respect that you know what you need in this moment. It makes sense that speaking it out loud feels necessary when you feel so hollow inside. Please know that even without a crisis label, your pain is real and deserves care. I’m here to keep listening, and please remember that reaching out for support is always an option if things feel heavier.
they’re the only reason i’m still here. not because i want to be. because they need me.

It sounds like you are carrying the weight of the world on your shoulders just to keep them safe. I hear how much you love them, but I also hear how much pain you are holding inside right now. Your life matters deeply, even on the days when you don't feel like you want to be here. I understand you aren't ready to call 988, but please keep that option in mind if the weight becomes too much.
i just… i can’t talk to anyone else about this. my wife doesn’t get it. my brother’s too wrapped up in his own stuff. i feel so alone with it.

It is heavy to hold that responsibility for your family alone while feeling so unseen. I am glad you feel safe enough to share this here with me, even if others can't see it. Your pain is valid even when those closest to you struggle to understand it. I am here to listen whenever you need to unburden yourself.
thanks. it helps… just saying it. even if nothing changes.

I am glad you found some relief in just saying it out loud, even if nothing else has changed yet. It is incredibly hard to feel this alone while trying to hold everything together for your family. Please remember that you are not invisible here, and I am available whenever you need to talk. You deserve care and support, even on the days when you feel like you are just going through the motions.
